notes.title: "TRICERATOPS SPECIES PACK" - HUGE FREE UPDATE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We proudly present the "Triceratops Species Pack" expansion to Dino Nest. This is a MAJOR free update with a herbivorous bonus content campaign added to the game and also a other exciting features, massive sharks, improvements, tweaks, optimizations and bug fixes. We hope for a smoother experience with faster progression and tons of high quality visual updates. To unlock the new bonus campaign just play to progress. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/cf3ba1a3d85ab4dd57c07cea10d9408ff4cd707c.png[/img]
[h2]New playable species "Triceratops"[/h2]
This addition to the game was decided by a community vote in 2022 for [i]"next playable species"[/i] to be added to Dino Nest. The name "Triceratops" means three-horned face. Bearing a large bony frill and large horns on the skull as defensive weapons against predators triceratops is one of the most recognizable of all dinosaurs and one of the most popular. It shared the landscape with and was most likely preyed upon by Tyrannosaurus Rex.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/8bb9fe757f5a45ef5ea4caf7da084887f3b27306.png[/img]
[h2]New feature "Auto quick battles"[/h2]
Auto resolve combat encounters function that should improve the gameplay for all carnivores in the game when out in the world.

[h2]New predator "Megalodon"[/h2]
Megalodon meaning "big tooth" was a massive gigantic shark, regarded as one of the largest and most powerful predators to have ever lived. Their teeth are thick and robust, built for grabbing prey and breaking bone. Their large jaws exert a bite force that could challenge Spinosaurus or even Giganotosaurus. This shark has been added to all water areas in the game.

[h3]Recommended to start a new game[/h3]
[i]Older savefiles from previous versions should be compatible with this new version but we recommend everyone to start a new game for all the new features to work correctly. We always appreciate and try our best to apply any feedback given by you to make the game the best experience it can possibly be, so dont forget to leave any feedback you may have in the forums. Thanks for your support![/i]

We always try to be optimistic when it comes to our releases but this time the new content and features for the Triceratops required alot of rebuilding of core game systems, it was a lot of work and since the game is not in Early Access anymore means that extra polish, bug fixing, achievements and optimization have to be in place as well before launch. notes.title: FULL RELEASE IS OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/cc908d7f1e9efc83a21f70a41505c38a50261eae.png[/img]

The full release is finally here and we begin a new journey! This update is truly massive, and some of the features in it have been in the works for months. We hope you will enjoy the game as much as we enjoy making it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/ce9086671bd62e8e4fff5438920fb8d98a24a22d.png[/img]

We have now been working on Dino Nest for over 2 years and it shaped up to be a game that we are really proud of. To create this new kind of special survival management game has been a complex and sometimes very challenging creative process. [b]Thank you for staying with us through this year of development, your feedback and amazing suggestions has helped us to get this game to where it is today. [/b]

Leaving Early Access is a big step forward for Dino Nest to be shown to a wider audience and it will help us to improve the game even more. Our plan going forward is to keep expanding with more features and content. There is huge potential for new unique gameplay that have not been touched yet that we strongly feel will fit the game perfectly. [b]We are incredibly excited about the future![/b]

Among other things, steam achievements will be added to the game in a future update (total of 46). But first we must make sure that the game is stable and well balanced with this huge rework of the difficulty challenge modes.

[h3]We recommend you to start a new game to fully enjoy the whole experience![/h3]

notes.content:

Hello everyone!

We have great news today. The release date for the next chapter is finally here!

Release date for the next major update to Dino Nest is now set to [b]28th April[/b]. We put our heart and soul into this project for over a year in Early Access and we now believe that the game is ready to leave Early Access and begin a new journey with this update so we proudly announce that this is the official release date for the full version of the game. This is a step forward for Dino Nest to be shown to a wider audience and it will help us to improve the game even more. 

[b]"The Predators Path"[/b] update is going to be the largest one yet not only in terms of content, but also the overall mechanics. We are currently working on bringing the jungle to life, implementing quests for a full campaign storyline. The storyline will introduce new gameplay in the world that will give more meaning to exploring and leave a trail for the player to follow.

We have now been working on Dino Nest now for over 2 years and it shaped up to be a game that we are really proud of. Our plan going forward is to keep expanding with more features and content even after the full release. There is huge potential for new unique gameplay that have not been touched yet that we strongly feel will fit the game perfectly.

Thank you for staying with us through this amazing year of development, your feedback and amazing suggestions has helped us to get this game to where it is now.

[h1]"The Predators Path" - Chapter IV[/h1]

[h2]- New Storyline campaign to follow![/h2]

Play a complete new special story campaign with quest progression and follow it to encounter new creatures in the jungle.

[h2]- New Territory System![/h2]

[h2]- New Boss Threat System![/h2]

You need to explore and hunt to find rare creatures in the world. Instead of being visible on the map from the get-go, Points of Interests and new rare apex boss encounters are now discovered by other means, such as being a threat in a certain area might attract the attention of other creatures or attacking other nests.

[h2]- Improved Exploring and Scouting![/h2]

In your hunting for prey or expanding territory you will have a chance to encounter many new Points of Interest and new unique rare apex creatures.

[h2]- New Creatures![/h2]

Encounter new carnivore enemy types in the jungle.

[h2]- New Legendary Difficulty![/h2]

Can you survive this new ultimate challenge? For the veterans out there.

The next chapter of Dino Nest is out. Get in there! This is a HUGE update with many new features. To unlock the new exciting things just play to progress. Have fun!

This update is our way to thank everyone who is already supporting us. For those of you that have not played Dino Nest yet, dont miss the chance to pick it up now for current reduced price. We plan to increase the price of the game abit very soon with all this new content and mechanics.

notes.title: 3 WEEKS LEFT TO LAUNCH...
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/abaa096abd81a3875e7c47ef6e72a32e7d4f5687.png[/img]

Hey there! Today is a good day to get hyped for the Dino Nest release that is arriving to Steam on April 29th! The game is a survival management sim. You are in control of a pack of dinos and your goal is to survive as a species as long as possible...

[b]Here is one of the creatures that you can encounter on the Island[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/7532910405bfd3b4e766927365dc93732dc193a2.png[/img]

[h1]YOUR NEST[/h1]
Subterranean nest with tunnels (completely below ground), protected living space and shelter 
for your dino pack. In the nest there will be management gameplay with a relaxing atmosphere. Here you are safe from all dangers in the jungle and can take care of your dinos and manage resources.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/bfee500807ea82c3bbdd196a125bf3f037acefb9.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] You can store food and leafs. 
[*] You can eat or rest to gain health. 
[*] You can build a hatchery and hatch baby dinos.
[*] You can scavenge for resources outside the cave entrance. 
[*] You can find water sources outside your nest and even deeper below ground.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/a6f209f391629fc56601cb6151fe514a3c832c15.png[/img]

[h1]GENETICS[/h1]
One important part of the game is that dino genes can affect many things. Genes can mutate and become stronger. When your dino grows in size,  health and damage scales based on your dinos genes.
Genes will be passed on from parents when you hatch the next generation. Genes can also affect the appearance of your dinos in different ways.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/cf0d02b36815b9612862fd50b2caeee2a26c4288.jpg[/img]

[h1]THE ISLAND[/h1]
The gameplay on the hunt is more like a roguelike strategy survival game. As you explore the island you will expand your hunting territory and encounter creatures of all sizes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/f7480645aee82b1e82dd4d1d475aec253aeb570a.jpg[/img]

All carnivores are hungry and wants to eat you. Be careful when you go to the waterhole to drink, there are usually alot of activity around the oasis. There are a total of 9 areas on the island with a different mix of creatures in each. Apex predators will move around to all different areas and can appear anywhere at any time. There is only one elder apex...

notes.title: Early Access of Dino Nest COMING OUT in 4 weeks!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38867807/aa7640a7b7458db83a98a2c9372be36b3f9879df.png[/img]

[b]Dino Nest [/b]is a brand new survival game that will launch in Early Access Thursday, April 29th, 2021. We cant wait to share this special game with you. There is something about it, a feeling, a spark of magic in the development so far that cant really be explained. Maybe it is a combination of a rock solid foundation to build on and a massive idea factory behind it. We love this game. There are so many directions we can take and opportunities for unique gameplay in the pipeline. We believe that your opinions are hugely important when ultimately deciding where the game should go next. At this point most of the foundations are already in place, there are still many currently-planned features and content additions we will be adding until the full release. Beyond such planned features, will be adding TONS of aspects suggested or iterated on by the community.

[b]We need your help to spread the word! [/b]
We want to create the best dinosaur survival management sim on the planet and we need your help. Your support, suggestions and feedback means the world to us! We feel that now is the right time to release to a wider audience to try the game out.

[h1]Early Access Information[/h1]

[b]Pricing[/b]
Digital download on Steam available April 29th, 2021
$6.99 with a 10% launch discount

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1373930/Dino_Nest/

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
“Dino Nest is an experimental survival game. We got something special cooking here but we dont really know exactly what it is yet or what it can become. Help us figure out what direction to take regarding design priorities such as polishing current features versus adding new ones and micromanagement versus automation in gameplay. We want to make Dino Nest the best it can be and the game can become way better with your help. Your support, suggestions and feedback means the world to us. We are actively working hard on fixing bugs, adjusting gameplay balance and adding new features and content.”

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]
“Dino Nest will be out of Early Access when we feel the main features have been validated and the game is confirmed to be mostly bug free. We estimate atleast 12 to 18 months of further development with community engagement. However, this is also depending on your feedback and ideas. We are looking forward to the further path we will take with Dino Nest together with our community and to an exciting early access phase with many ideas, suggestions and feedback.”

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]
“The full version will contain quality improvements as well as new and expanded gameplay elements and features. There are a few loose ends that we want to tie up as well as some exiting roadmap steps. For example late game fighting over hunting territory on the island, special interactions between jungle wildlife, pack leader traits and rare genetic mutations.”

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]
“The core of Dino Nest is there, fully playable and technically stable. You can manage your own pack of dinos, maintain your nest and hatch next generation. All your actions will impact survival elements such as hunger, thirst, health and growth status. There is jungle wildlife interaction with plenty of carnivores and herbivores. There is a map with exploration and expansion of hunting territory. There is unique events and decisions with direct impact on gameplay. The detailed talent tree for dinosaur pack genetic DNA mutations (upgrades, talents and traits) is also in place.”

[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b]
“Yes, we would like to thank everyone who is already supporting us during Early Access with a reduced price for that period. The final pricing decision will be based on various factors such as the scope of added content and improvements to the game over time.”

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b]
“We will communicate with the community through the Dino Nest community forum here on Steam. We will listen to feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. All ideas, suggestions and feedback means the world to us. We are looking forward to the further path we will take with Dino Nest together with our community.”
